summary: Vaxart filed an 8-K disclosing topline 12-month safety data from a ~400-participant sentinel safety cohort of its Phase 2b trial for an oral pill COVID-19 vaccine. The data showed no vaccine-related SAEs or sustained Grade 3+ AEs versus an approved mRNA comparator. The filing is a routine clinical trial update, not a special-situation transaction such as a merger or restructuring. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are involved. The event is a standard business update with no risk-arb angle or regulatory clock to watch.
